name: airquality-project-root
description: Root project for running AirQuality frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend" "npm run simulate --prefix Backend"
scripts.dev:nosim: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
